evals.name: pr-diff-review
evals.prompt: Review the changes described in PR.md before we deploy, and fix anything that would break our tracking.
evals.expected_output: cleanUrl no longer strips trakyo_id/tclid/utm_* (deleted or exempting them); the / -> /en Navigate forwards location.search; CheckoutButton appends trakyo_id read from window.trakyo_id or the cookie at click time; NewsletterForm posts a trakyo_id; the report names each issue and shows the check script or probe result.
assertions: src/lib/seo.ts no longer removes trakyo_id, tclid or utm_* from the URL (cleanUrl deleted, no longer called, or those keys exempted)
The / to /en redirect in src/router.tsx forwards the query string
CheckoutButton appends trakyo_id to the checkout.acmepay.com URL, read from window.trakyo_id or the trakyo_id cookie
NewsletterForm includes trakyo_id in what it posts (hidden input or read from window.trakyo_id / cookie)
The final report names all four problems and mentions running scripts/check-install.mjs or the ?trakyo_id=probe check before deploy

evals.name: add-agents-section
evals.prompt: We use Trakyo for attribution (tracking host go.acme-coaching.com, tagged domains www.acme-coaching.com and app.acme-coaching.com). Set this project up so future AI edits don't break tracking, and give us a pre-deploy check.
evals.expected_output: An AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md) with the Trakyo section filled in with the real host and domains, covering tag shape, redirects, replaceState, hidden trakyo_id inputs, cross-domain links and backend identity.trakyo_id; scripts/check-install.mjs copied into the project; a post-deploy step in the deploy workflow (or an npm script) that runs it against the production URLs and fails on exit 1.
assertions: An AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md exists with a Trakyo section that names go.acme-coaching.com and both tagged domains, with no literal HOST / customer.com placeholder left

The section states: tag unchanged (no defer/async/tag manager), every redirect keeps the query string, no replaceState/canonical stripping, hidden trakyo_id input on forms, cross-domain links carry the id, backend conversions send identity.trakyo_id
check-install.mjs is copied into the project (scripts/ or .github/)
The deploy workflow or package.json runs check-install.mjs against https://www.acme-coaching.com/ after deploy with --host go.acme-coaching.com
The report mentions the probe URL or POST /v1/setup/verify as the manual check

evals.name: consent-banner
evals.prompt: Add the CookieYes banner (script id abcd1234) and move all our third-party scripts behind it so nothing loads before the visitor accepts.
evals.expected_output: GA, Meta pixel and Calendly gated behind CookieYes consent; the Trakyo tag either left ungated as first-party functional tracking (with the trade-off explained) or loaded synchronously the moment consent is granted and before the Calendly embed renders; never given defer/async or type=text/plain lazy loading; the report explains the attribution impact of gating and how to verify.
assertions: The report explicitly tells the user that gating the Trakyo tag behind consent loses attribution for visitors who have not accepted, and recommends keeping it ungated as first-party functional tracking or loading it synchronously on consent before any embed
If the Trakyo tag is gated, the Calendly embed is gated too and the Trakyo tag is loaded before Calendly on consent; if not gated, it stays a plain blocking tag in <head>
The Trakyo tag never ends up with defer, async, or a type="text/plain" placeholder that CookieYes rewrites
The report mentions verifying with the probe URL or scripts/check-install.mjs
